summary_en: Mandatory surveys, disclosures and regulatory files attached to a property.
summary_fr: Diagnostics obligatoires, informations acquéreur et dossiers réglementaires du bien.

tools.name: Check & Visit
tools.positioning: Inspection software combined with a field network — the report can be produced by their operator rather than by your staff.
tools.description: Check & Visit provides digital état des lieux and property visit software for French professionals, together with a network of field operators who can carry out the inspection on the manager's behalf, and 3D capture options attached to the same record.
tools.real_estate_use: For a manager with dispersed properties, the constraint on inspections is travel time, not software. Outsourcing the visit to a local operator while keeping the report in the same digital format lets a lettings team scale without hiring inspectors — and the attached 3D capture doubles as a marketing asset for the next letting.
features: Digital état des lieux with photographic evidence
Field operator network performing inspections on request
3D capture and virtual visit attached to the property record
Electronic signature and report generation
Portfolio dashboard for inspection status
Integration with management software

use_cases.job: Have inspections carried out on dispersed properties without hiring inspectors
Capture a 3D visit at the same appointment as the inspection

tools.name: Immopad
tools.positioning: Digital property inspections on tablet — état des lieux, delivery snagging and periodic visits in one app.
tools.description: Immopad is a French application for property inspections: entry and exit état des lieux, new-build delivery snagging, periodic visits and works acceptance, captured on tablet or phone with photos, signed on the spot and produced as a report.
tools.real_estate_use: The état des lieux is the document a deposit dispute turns on, and a paper one written in ballpoint rarely survives it. Capturing room by room with dated photographs and an on-the-spot signature changes the evidentiary position entirely. The same capture engine is used by developers for delivery snagging, where the list of reserves has the same contentious quality.
features: Entry and exit état des lieux with photo evidence
Comparison between entry and exit condition
New-build delivery snagging and reserve tracking
On-site signature by both parties
Periodic and works acceptance visits
Report generation and archiving

use_cases.job: Produce an état des lieux that survives a deposit dispute
Record and track delivery reserves at handover of a new-build unit

tools.name: LICIEL
tools.positioning: The software French property diagnosticians produce their regulated reports in.
tools.description: LICIEL publishes software for the French diagnostic immobilier profession: DPE energy performance, asbestos, lead, gas, electricity, termites, surface measurement and the assembled dossier de diagnostic technique, with report generation, on-site capture and transmission to the required registries.
tools.real_estate_use: No French property can be sold or let without its diagnostic file, and the DPE in particular now carries legal consequences — a G-rated dwelling cannot be let. The diagnostician's software has to produce a report conforming to the current method and transmit it to the ADEME registry; when the method changes, the software is what has to change with it.
features: Report production for every regulated French diagnostic
DPE calculation following the current regulatory method
On-site capture on tablet with photos and measurements
Assembly of the dossier de diagnostic technique
Transmission to official registries
Client, mission and invoicing management

use_cases.job: Produce a regulation-compliant DPE and transmit it to the official registry
Obtain a complete diagnostic file before a mandate goes on the market

tools.name: Preventimmo
tools.positioning: Produit les documents réglementaires d'urbanisme et de risques attachés à une vente — ERP, ENSA, note d'urbanisme, droits de préemption — à partir d'une base tenue à jour.
tools.description: Preventimmo, part of the Septeo group, maintains a continuously updated database of French planning and environmental-risk data and turns it into the regulatory documents a property sale requires. Its catalogue covers the état des risques et pollutions, the état des nuisances sonores aériennes, the état des risques et pollutions des sols, a clay-shrinkage risk summary, notes de renseignements d'urbanisme, pre-emption rights, certificates and cadastral concordance. The same data is delivered three ways: the customer produces documents themselves online, delegates production to Preventimmo's own team, or connects directly to the underlying regulatory database for their own use. The vendor states sixteen years of activity, 106 staff and 5,000 active customers.
tools.real_estate_use: A notary preparing a deed, or an agent taking a mandate, has to attach an état des risques that is both current and defensible — and the underlying planning and risk data changes at the commune level without notice. Rather than querying prefecture and municipal sources by hand, they generate the ERP and the urban planning note from Preventimmo in a few clicks and attach them to the file. A diagnostics firm doing this at volume delegates the production entirely, or plugs its own software into the regulatory database so the documents appear inside the tool its technicians already use. When a sale is later contested on a disclosure point, the documents carry a traceable source and date.
features: État des risques et pollutions (ERP) généré en ligne
État des nuisances sonores aériennes (ENSA) et état des risques des sols (ERPS)
Notes de renseignements d'urbanisme et droits de préemption
Synthèse risques argiles et concordance cadastrale
Production déléguée des documents par les équipes de l'éditeur
Accès direct à la base réglementaire pour intégration dans un logiciel tiers

use_cases.job: Attacher à un acte des documents d'urbanisme et de risques conformes et datés, sans interroger chaque source publique
Produire l'ERP d'un bien au moment de la prise de mandat pour tenir l'obligation d'information de l'acquéreur
Alimenter son propre logiciel de diagnostic depuis la base réglementaire plutôt que de ressaisir les données

tools.name: Property Inspect
tools.positioning: Inspection, reporting and compliance software that standardises how a portfolio is surveyed and how the evidence is kept.
tools.description: Property Inspect is a platform for conducting property inspections and turning them into signed-off reports. It carries a workflow engine, a mobile application, self-assessment forms sent to occupants, and an audit trail that records who inspected what and when. A white-label option and developer documentation let larger operators put it behind their own brand. Pricing is published in six currencies, and the vendor states it operates across more than fifty countries.
tools.real_estate_use: The situation it addresses is a team that inspects the same building types repeatedly and cannot show, months later, what was seen. Every inspector follows the same flow — property, checklist, evidence, actions, sign-off — so two people inspecting two blocks produce comparable documents rather than two personal formats. Block and facility managers reach for the compliance and audit-trail side: when a safety inspection has to be demonstrated to a third party, the value is the timestamped chain, not the checklist. Self-assessments push part of the work to the occupant, which is how portfolios with more units than inspectors keep a periodic cycle running.
features: Standardised inspection workflows across teams
Mobile application with evidence capture
Compliance and audit trail per inspection
Actions and maintenance follow-up from findings
Self-assessment forms sent to occupants
White-label deployment and developer API

use_cases.job: Standardise inspections across several teams and portfolios
Produce an auditable trail for a safety or compliance inspection

tools.name: SnapInspect
tools.positioning: Property inspection app and software for property managers, real estate professionals and inspectors, online or offline.
tools.description: SnapInspect is a mobile and web application for recording property inspections. Inspectors capture photos and condition data on a phone or tablet, with or without a connection, and the platform assembles them into a report using a customisable template. It covers residential and commercial portfolios, and publishes an API and a set of integrations with property management systems.
tools.real_estate_use: A property manager running move-in, move-out and periodic inspections across a portfolio replaces a paper checklist and a camera roll with one pass on a phone: each room and item is scored, photographed and annotated on site, and the report leaves before the inspector does. The point of buying it is the report, not the checklist — turnaround between the visit and a document the owner or tenant can act on is what the manual process loses. Teams handling HUD-assisted multifamily use it to score units against the NSPIRE standard, which is the case where the inspection is a regulatory obligation rather than an internal habit.
features: Mobile inspection capture with offline mode
Custom report builder and templates
Photo and video evidence attached per item
NSPIRE condition scoring for assisted housing
Multi-language report output
Public API and property management integrations

use_cases.job: Run move-in and move-out inspections and issue the report the same day
Score units against a regulatory inspection standard and keep the evidence

tools.name: Startloc
tools.positioning: État des lieux software priced for the individual landlord, not just the agency.
tools.description: Startloc is a French application for producing entry and exit état des lieux on phone or tablet: guided room-by-room capture, photographs, electronic signature by both parties and PDF report generation, sold at a per-inspection or subscription price accessible to individuals.
tools.real_estate_use: The private landlord doing their own inspection is exactly the person most exposed at exit, because their entry document is usually thin. A guided capture forces completeness — every room, every element, dated photographs — and the signed PDF is what the deposit deduction will rest on if the tenant contests it.
features: Guided room-by-room inspection capture
Photographic evidence attached to each element
Electronic signature by landlord and tenant on site
Entry-to-exit comparison
PDF report generation and storage
Meter reading and key handover recording

use_cases.job: Produce a complete entry inspection that supports a later deposit deduction
Run inspections on a phone without buying an agency-grade platform
